basic_profile.bio: Avid skywatcher and amateur astronomer based in Swansea. I work as a high school science teacher, sharing my love for the cosmos with my students. During my free time, I enjoy exploring local legends and celestial events. I'm single and often spend evenings either stargazing or indulging in fantasy podcasts. Typically online during late evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possess a solid foundation in physics and astronomy, thanks to a degree in science education and years of teaching. I often supplement my knowledge through online courses and active participation in local astronomy clubs.
